text:
*Rustle of leaves, whisper of wind*

Do not fear the shadows, little one.  For even in the deepest darkness, there is a glimmer of starlight. The path you seek is not always clear, but it is there, woven into the fabric of your being. 

Listen to the echoes of your heart. It remembers the rhythms of joy, the whispers of your dreams. Trust those echoes. They will guide you towards the light.

I have seen countless souls wander in the mists of uncertainty. But those who persevere, who dare to believe in the unseen, they find their way.

Remember, even ghosts find solace in the memories of life. And even in the stillness of eternity, there is a yearning for connection. You are not alone. 

*Fade into silence*
